name: Issue Reporter
description: Resource-efficient Jellyfin plugin for plugin developers that monitors plugin logs, masks sensitive data across 4 layers, deduplicates GitHub issues with version intelligence, and auto-fills issue templates.
overview: Automated GitHub issue reporter for Jellyfin plugin developers with 4-layer zero-leak redaction, ETag caching, anti-spam protections, and persistent retry outbox.

versions.changelog: Deduplicate TargetKeys and guard BackgroundService startup.
Initial release with O(1) ILoggerProvider, 4-layer redaction + Leak Guard, ETag GitHub client, anti-spam flood breaker, retry outbox, and issue template engine.
